mapper.sql: id,owner_id,puzzle_version_id,first_seat,mode,status,CAST(initial_state AS CHAR) AS initial_state_json,CAST(current_state AS CHAR) AS current_state_json,state_version,winner_side,robot_status,hint_count,create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM game_session WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1

SELECT sequence_no,actor_seat,actor_type,CAST(move_json AS CHAR) AS move_json,before_version,after_version,CAST(after_state AS CHAR) AS after_state_json,decision_quality,create_time FROM game_action WHERE game_id=#{gameId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY sequence_no ASC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_action WHERE game_id=#{gameId} AND deleted=0
SELECT FROM game_session WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND robot_status='QUEUED' AND deleted=0 ORDER BY update_time ASC,id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE game_session SET update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),robot_status='THINKING' WHERE id=#{id} AND state_version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE' AND robot_status='QUEUED' AND deleted=0

UPDATE game_session SET update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),current_state=CAST(#{state} AS JSON),state_version=state_version+1,status=#{status},winner_side=#{winnerSide},robot_status=#{robotStatus},finished_time=IF(#{status}='FINISHED',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),NULL) WHERE id=#{id} AND state_version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE' AND deleted=0
UPDATE game_action SET deleted=1,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE game_id=#{gameId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE game_session SET update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),hint_count=hint_count+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND state_version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE' AND deleted=0

UPDATE game_session SET update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),update_by=#{updateBy},current_state=CAST(#{initialState} AS JSON),state_version=state_version+1,status='ACTIVE',winner_side=NULL,robot_status=#{robotStatus},mode=#{mode},hint_count=0,finished_time=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND state_version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted=0

UPDATE game_session SET update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),update_by=#{updateBy},state_version=state_version+1,status='ABANDONED',winner_side=NULL,robot_status='IDLE',finished_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND state_version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE' AND deleted=0
UPDATE game_session SET update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),robot_status='FAILED' WHERE id=#{id} AND state_version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE' AND robot_status='THINKING' AND deleted=0
UPDATE game_session SET update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),robot_status='NEEDS_PROOF' WHERE id=#{id} AND state_version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE' AND robot_status='THINKING' AND deleted=0
